cases.name: 1. CORS: verifies old-origin headers, preflight OPTIONS, allowed list, and disallowed rejection
cases.details: play.antimatterinnovations.com receives Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; preflight OPTIONS returns 204.

cases.name: 2. Cookie auth continuity: resolves session via __Host-mega_session and dev session cookies
cases.details: __Host-mega_session cookie resolves correctly via accounts.requireLinked to caller profile.

cases.name: 3. CSRF: cookie-authenticated mutating requests require allowed Origin/Referer or 403 ORIGIN_OR_CONTENT_TYPE
cases.details: Cookie-authenticated POST from forged/unauthorized origin rejected with 403 ORIGIN_OR_CONTENT_TYPE.

cases.name: 4. Genuinely read-only GETs: /api/v1/queue, /api/v1/match/:id, and /api/v1/invitations mutate zero DB state
cases.details: GET /api/v1/queue and GET /api/v1/match/:id return status without performing lazy database writes or mutations.

cases.name: 5. Legacy /api/v1/profile compatibility: returns exact expected JSON shape with wallet, tier, and history
cases.details: Returns exact legacy JSON shape { id, friendCode, name, rating, games, tier, wallet, records, daily, friends } from PostgreSQL.

cases.name: 6. Zero SQLite writes: asserts zero SQLite files created or modified during PostgreSQL operations
cases.details: Verified that zero SQLite files (*.sqlite, *.sqlite3, *.db) are created or modified during tests.

cases.name: 7. Teardown & handle management: harness cleanly drops loopback servers and connection pools
cases.details: Harness closes server connections and connection pools cleanly without lingering handles.

verification.summary: Old-origin browser client compatibility facade implemented in apps/api/middleware/cors.js, csrf.js, and routes/compat.js. Verified CORS for play.antimatterinnovations.com, cookie auth continuity, CSRF enforcement, genuinely read-only GETs, legacy profile shape, and zero SQLite writes across 7 dedicated tests on real PG16.
